description: This file defines the EntityDataReader class, which models the <entity-data-reader> element from an XML configuration in the OFBiz framework. It manages resource references associated with entity data reading configurations.

classes.name: EntityDataReader
classes.description: Models an <entity-data-reader> element in entity configuration, handling its name attribute and child resource elements.

methods.name: EntityDataReader(String)
methods.description: Constructs an EntityDataReader with a specified name, initializing resource list as empty.

methods.name: EntityDataReader(Element)
methods.description: Constructs an EntityDataReader from an XML Element, parsing name attribute and resource child elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of this EntityDataReader.

methods.name: getResourceList
methods.description: Returns the list of resource references associated with this reader.
